system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: each agent in our architecture carries a focused prompt for its specific role
system_prompt_style.note: Per-role prompts; retrieved context and message filtering by FSM state suggest runtime composition; mechanism not shown.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: agents perceive summaries, schemas, and sample rows rather than full datasets or API responses
env_context_strategy.note: Retriever injects memory/metadata context and agents write code to explore data; paper only.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Summarizers: Distill intermediate results into compact summaries for downstream agents, enabling context mini-mization without losing decision-relevant information.
context_compaction.note: Raw tool outputs withheld from context (Sec. 3.4.1).

observation_format.evidence_quote: agents perceive summaries, schemas, and sample rows rather than full datasets or API responses
observation_format.note: Inter-agent messages are Pydantic-typed; observation format to model inferred as text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Agents write code to in-voke tools (MCP servers, APIs) rather than calling them directly

tool_count.note: Paper only; no tool schema list. 50+ agents, 32 data writers mentioned.

edit_primitive.note: No edit tool described; paper only.

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schema source described; MCP servers invoked from code.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: agents write code that invokes tools like MCP servers

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Execution follows a fixed, sequenced pattern:Planner first, Critics last, with iterative loops in between.
loop_primitives.note: FSM routing; critic rejection triggers retry.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The planner gen-erates an execution DAG with pre-declared success criteria and acceptance gates.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Decision-making follows a strict hierar-chy, never horizontal consensus.
multi_agent_topology.note: 50+ agents organized in teams with coordinators; closest value hierarchical.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Handoff pattern: Agents delegate to specialists; PlanMan-ager routes to PlanExecutor→ CodingInnerLoopTeam→ Critics
delegation_mechanism.note: Structured message passing kernel also present; sub-agents may be spawned by executors.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: No execution proceeds without human sign-off on the plan and its criteria.
human_in_loop.note: Escalation to user gates on policy violations also described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the entire ordered state of all agents (including their con-text, reasoning, intermediate results, and execution status)

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Vector memory (PostgreSQL + pgvector) cap-tures insights; indexed by scope (account/user/session)

state_persistence.evidence_quote: users can return days or weeks later to re-sume from the exact checkpoint

self_verification.evidence_quote: writers and critics run on different model providers to achieve cognitive diversity and avoid monoculture
self_verification.note: Code, Chart, Output, Plan critics with veto.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This loop repeats until critics approve or escalation occurs.
retry_policy.note: Retry is critic-triggered within team; escalation after persistent rejection; cap unspecified.

rollback.evidence_quote: users can time-travel backward to any previous checkpoint to undo changes

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Only inde-pendent critics can approve work for advancement.
termination_condition.note: Completion via critic approval; escalation to user on persistent failure; no caps described (paper-only, not coded as absent).

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Writers start with fast, economical models; upgrade only on critique failure.

timeouts.note: No timeout configuration described; paper only.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Transformation code and tool invoca-tions execute in isolated environment

network_policy.note: No network policy described; paper only.

permission_model.note: Policy violations escalate to user gate.

replayability.evidence_quote: Each checkpoint represents a complete, reproducible snapshot of the multi-agent system state.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Policy violations (guardrails triggered, security constraints violated, compliance checks failed) immediately escalate to a user gate
guardrails.note: PII kept in execution layer (data isolation), not a filter per se.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Our evaluation covers financial analysis ex-clusively.

open_source.note: No repo or licence; commercial production system by Isotopes AI.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Different agents can use different providers
